# M22-S6 D7: eject reproduces native output for `$"..."` inside a lambda
# body, expression or block (T-Sec11, T-104.4).
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^n1$'
stdout '^m1$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cd ..
cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectinterplambda

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func conv(g func(int) string) string { return g(1) }

func main() {
	fmt.Println(conv(x => $"n{x}"))
	fmt.Println(conv(x => { return $"m{x}" }))
}
